ns2:course.label: Biochemistry Seminar
ns2:course.description: Students, faculty, and invited speakers present seminars and discussions on current research topics. Required of all Biochemistry Ph.D. students. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in Biochemistry.

ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Registration is limited to graduate students whose major is Biochemistry.
